theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiTM_integral_bound_of_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Rn N)) (a : Rn N) (ρ M : ℝ) (g : Rn N → ℝ), ν (Metric.ball a ρ) < ∞ → Continuous g → (∀ y, |g y| ≤ M) → (∀ y, g y ≠ 0 → y ∈ Metric.ball a ρ) → Integrable g ν ∧ |∫ y, g y ∂ν| ≤ M * ν.real (Metric.ball a ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
